What we want to emphasize is that there was no increase in the total investment in the road safety programs Conducted. What happened is that the existing resources were now strategically planned and directed to the hotspots and critical profiles, to evidence— through evidence-based interventions. Such progress— such programs cost less than the impact of a fatal crash. And in our experience, organizations such as Ambev, Porto Seguro, iFood, and many others in Brazil joined forces to make it possible. This seems intuitive, but it's not simple.
